name: Guijo de Galisteo (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided green over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Guijo de Galisteo (a cauldron on red above roundels).
history: Municipal flag of Guijo de Galisteo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Guijo de Galisteo arms — cauldron above roundels
